entries.text: With its boss out of the picture, the Segin Squad\nis pretty much done for.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_04a

entries.text: Now that its boss has been taken down, the Navi\nSquad’s days are numbered.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_04b

entries.text: With its boss no longer around, the Ruchbah\nSquad is as good as finished.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_04c

entries.text: Now that there’s no boss to lead them, the rest\nof the Schedar Squad shouldn’t last long.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_04d

entries.text: Without its boss, the Caph Squad should be a\nhair’s breadth from disbanding.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_04e

entries.text: ... ... ...\nNow Giacomo, too...[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_05a

entries.text: ... ... ...\nNow Atticus, too...[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_05b

entries.text: Sorry, I’ve got a lot on my mind right now...[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_06

entries.text: So, Operation Starfall. You’ve taken down all but\ntwo bases, so it’s fair to say it’s going well.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_07

entries.text: This seems like a good time to let you know what\nwe’re ultimately aiming to achieve.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_08

entries.text: Our final goal...is to defeat the mastermind that\nfirst recruited the five squad bosses and created\r\nTeam Star. The one they call the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]big boss[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_09

entries.text: What’s this person like?
entries.label: team_0070_select_01

entries.text: Who is this “big boss”?
entries.label: team_0070_select_02

entries.text: Who knows? They control the five squad bosses\nfrom the shadows... That’s all anyone can say.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_10

entries.text: If we defeat this person and get them to declare\nthe team disbanded, that’ll be it for Team Star.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_11

entries.text: Since the big boss never set up their own base\nand keeps their identity hidden, I take it they’re\r\nnot one for the spotlight.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_12

entries.text: But once all the squad bosses are out of action,\nthe big boss’ll finally have to take the stage.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_13

entries.text: Now, about your reward. I’ll transfer some LP\nover to your phone, as promised.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_15

entries.text: You earned 7,000 LP!
entries.label: team_0070_system_02

entries.text: You can now make more kinds of TMs using the\nTM Machine!
entries.label: team_0070_system_03

entries.text: Have your Pokémon learn strong moves so that\nthey can continue to be of use to the operation.\c\nMy supply unit rep should be with you soon.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_14

entries.text: That, uh...sounded like a pretty serious\nphone call.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0070_botan_02

entries.text: Agias!
entries.label: team_0070_legend_01

entries.text: Uwagh! I wasn’t talking to you![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0070_botan_03

entries.text: Aaarrrggghhh![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0070_botan_04

entries.text: So, that mastermind you were talking about...\nCassiopeia’s mentioned them to me, too.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0070_botan_05

entries.text: Team Star’s founder... The person who’s caused\nall kinds of misery at the academy...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0070_botan_06

entries.text: If we don’t take them down, I’ll lose what I\ntreasure most in the world.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0070_botan_07

entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.label: team_0070_select_03

entries.text: You’ll lose your treasure?
entries.label: team_0070_select_04

entries.text: Ah, no—I just...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0070_botan_08

entries.text: Um...that’s right! You need your reward!\nHere—take it before I forget.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0070_botan_09

entries.text: You received lots of Pokémon [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]materials[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!
entries.label: team_0070_system_04

entries.text: All right, well, I’ll be off, then...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
